item.title: Anti-Israel graffiti found in snow at Yale University
item.description: Elijah Wiesel, a sophomore who saw the graffiti, told JNS that, while the incident does not appear to have had much campus impact, it seems to reflect “broader Jew-hatred on campus.” The post Anti-Israel graffiti found in snow at Yale University appeared first on JNS.org.

item.title: Evangelical self-confidence, anxiety about wider culture at Judeo-Christian Zionist event
item.description: Growing opposition to Israel on the political right is “serious, but thank God it’s not really an evangelical problem,” Rev. Johnnie Moore told JNS. The post Evangelical self-confidence, anxiety about wider culture at Judeo-Christian Zionist event appeared first on JNS.org.

item.title: DePaul University investigating ‘inexcusable’ harassment of Jewish students at Chicago cafe
item.description: The incident shows how vital it is students are “allowed to be visibly, proudly Jewish without fear,” the executive director of Metro Chicago Hillel told JNS.
